name: 32117 · Daytona Beach, FL
findings: ZIP 32117 (Daytona Beach) has 99 nonprofit organizations. 36 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32117 (Daytona Beach) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 32117 (Daytona Beach) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).
